FAQ

Quick answers

Can’t find your answer? Talk to our team.

What are global impact models and calculators?

Online tools that estimate the economic contribution of an organisation, project or investment. They trace global supply chains, capturing international, national and local impact in one model, with results for economic output (GDP/GVA), employment and tax revenues, plus selected social impact measures.

Who are they for?

Businesses, universities and teams planning or delivering capital projects, plus packages for consulting teams. Typical users include corporate strategy, sustainability, public affairs and communications teams, developers and planning bodies.

Where can impacts be measured?

The platform covers 185 countries and more than 6,000 geographies, with up to 402 sectors. The level of geographic detail depends on the calculator and subscription plan.

Can I explore different scenarios?

You can change your inputs to see how different assumptions affect the estimate. Scenario comparison varies by calculator, so ask our team about your use case.

How can I see one in action?

Request a demo and we’ll discuss which calculator is most relevant to your organisation or project.

See it in action

Request a demo and we’ll show you which calculator fits. Provide your details and a member of our team will be in touch to discuss the best approach for your organisation.
